apps.title: RealWorld (Conduit)
apps.about: The RealWorld blogging API: users, profiles, articles, comments, tags, follows and favorites. Every implementation passes the same pinned Hurl suite.
apps.seed: 100 users, 10,000 articles with two tags each, 10,000 comments, 1,000 follows, 5,000 favorites.

impls.stack: Rust, axum, sqlx, h5i-app kernel with Lean proofs
Rust, axum, the h5i-app engine (h5i-app-pg) with Lean proofs

scenarios.requests: GET /api/articles: limit 20 at offset 0, a later offset, and tag=tagN

apps.title: linkding
apps.about: The linkding bookmark manager's REST API. The Hurl suite was checked against the pinned 1.47.0 image, which also runs in the benchmark as a reference.
apps.seed: 50 users, 100,000 bookmarks and 2,000 tags owned by one user, two tags per bookmark.

impls.stack: Rust, axum, the h5i-app engine (h5i-app-pg): kernel, read plans and writes with Lean proofs
Rust, axum, sqlx, h5i-app kernel with Lean proofs

scenarios.requests: 40% list, 20% search, 15% get, 10% tags, 8% update, 5% archive, 2% create
